_doc: Arena 10 (retail world 41: a butcher's kitchen) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena7/kit.json (kind cap = lies over another block's top: y = 0 is that top). Its blood drain and butcher's axes are in the arena 9 kit; pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are found by map_sheet.py.

pieces.name: brick_slab
pieces.label: Losa de ladrillos
pieces.note: lies over a wooden post (984, 985): y = 0 is the post's top; three by three soft square bricks; the kitchen floor

pieces.name: wood_post
pieces.label: Poste de madera
pieces.note: a cell-wide block of old timber under the floor; the brick slab (2736) caps it; stack them for taller drops

pieces.name: wood_post_alt
pieces.label: Poste de madera (otro corte)
pieces.note: the same post, its timbers cut another way

pieces.name: blood_river
pieces.label: Río de sangre
pieces.note: a cell of glossy blood edge to edge; a run of them is the river, a step below the floor

pieces.name: blood_gutter
pieces.label: Canaleta de sangre
pieces.note: lies on a floor slab: blood between two low pale curbs, along x, edge to edge so gutters chain

pieces.name: blood_gutter_corner
pieces.label: Canaleta de sangre (esquina)
pieces.note: the gutter turning from +x to +z at the cell's centre

pieces.name: blood_stream
pieces.label: Chorro de sangre
pieces.note: y = 0 is the floor rim a gutter pours over, x = 0 its face; falls about 1.3 m into a splash

pieces.name: blood_fall
pieces.label: Cascada de sangre
pieces.note: a river cell pouring over its +x side, about 5.5 m down the island's edge; turn it to face the drop

pieces.name: cage
pieces.label: Jaula
pieces.note: a low cage of thick planks and round bars, a little wider than the cell; 2741 is the same cage turned 90°

pieces.name: cage_chicken
pieces.label: Jaula con pollo
pieces.note: the cage with a chicken inside, facing +x

pieces.name: cage_open
pieces.label: Jaula abierta
pieces.note: a taller hutch, its lid open on the -x side, straw and two chickens inside

pieces.name: cage_broken
pieces.label: Jaula rota
pieces.note: the floor planks whole, the lid slid off leaning to +x, bars knocked over

pieces.name: low_table
pieces.label: Mesa baja
pieces.note: a thick plank top on four bundled legs, about 0.55 m; the tablecloth (2651) goes on top

pieces.name: tablecloth
pieces.label: Mantel
pieces.note: lies on the low table's top (y = 0 is that top), hanging over its +x side

pieces.name: meat_crates
pieces.label: Cajas con embutidos
pieces.note: two golden crates stacked, the top one heaped with hams, steaks and sausages

pieces.name: meat_crates_spilled
pieces.label: Cajas con embutidos (caídos)
pieces.note: the same crates, a ham fallen against the front, sausages on the floor

pieces.name: meat_basket
pieces.label: Cesta de embutidos
pieces.note: a round wicker basket heaped with cuts, blood dripping under it

pieces.name: ribcage
pieces.label: Costillar
pieces.note: a big ribcage lying on its side, the spine along x

pieces.name: ribcage_small
pieces.label: Costillar pequeño
pieces.note: a little ribcage lying flat like a fish's bones, a loose bone beside it

pieces.name: ribcage_standing
pieces.label: Costillar de pie
pieces.note: a small ribcage stood on its rib tips, the spine on top

pieces.name: grease_stain
pieces.label: Losa manchada (grasa)
pieces.note: yellow grease spilt in a ring on a floor slab

pieces.name: grease_stain_small
pieces.label: Losa manchada (grasa, pequeña)
pieces.note: one sprawling splash of grease on a floor slab

pieces.name: severed_leg
pieces.label: Pierna con el hueso asomando
pieces.note: a leg standing in its boot, the bone out of the cut, about 0.65 m

pieces.name: severed_leg_lying
pieces.label: Pierna con el hueso asomando (tumbada)
pieces.note: the same leg fallen along x, blood at the cut

pieces.name: bone_box
pieces.label: Caja rota con huesos
pieces.note: an open box with bones and meat inside, blood down its +z side

pieces.name: tall_box
pieces.label: Caja alta
pieces.note: a closed framed box about 1.3 m tall

pieces.name: bear_trap
pieces.label: Trampa de suelo
pieces.note: a steel bear trap lying open

pieces.name: tusks
pieces.label: Colmillos
pieces.note: four great curved tusks heaped, curling over to -x in screen terms

pieces.name: stakes
pieces.label: Pinchos
pieces.note: five sharpened stakes driven into the floor

pieces.name: barrel_tap
pieces.label: Barril
pieces.note: a barrel lying along x on two cradles, its tap at +x

pieces.name: soup_tub
pieces.label: Tina de sopa
pieces.note: a wooden tub of green soup, a ladle in it, a cloth over its -x rim
